findings.claim: An empty ROWS value yields zero rows, so the case ends with state "recorded", no lenses and exit 0. That looks like a successful review with no findings, which would score as a clean miss. An unreadable ROWS_FILE is also reported as "unknown row <x>", because jq's failure is folded into the same message. Both are operator-input edge cases outside the default path. A one-line check that at least one row was given, and a separate message for an unreadable rows file, would fix them.
